Hi Laura — thanks for the clear asks. Summary here so you have something for the binder; I’ve also attached a brief export spec and linked a longer runbook.

High-level (TL;DR)
- Access logs (per-request traces): default hosted retention = 90 days; Dedicated/Private can be configured up to 7 years on request (contracted).
- Tenant audit logs (configuration/role changes, admin actions): default retention = 365 days for hosted; Dedicated/Private configurable to customer policy up to 7 years.
- Export formats: ndjson (newline-delimited JSON) or compressed JSON/CSV for tabular fields. Manifests are delivered as signed JSON and include per-file checksum (SHA256) and record counts.
- Delivery SLA: standard export window for a requested range is up to 48 hours for hosted exports, 72 hours for large handovers (>1TB). Dedicated/Private: we offer a scheduled daily snapshot or on-demand extract with agreed SLA in the contract.
- Deletion proof: we provide an export manifest showing the exact objects removed and a deletion token signed by Redwood with timestamp and manifest hash. For Dedicated/Private we can also provide an attestation letter for contractual purposes.
- Data residency: exports can be scoped to EU-only where your tenant is in our EU region. For hosted customers we guarantee EU-located exports for EU tenant data unless explicitly requested otherwise. Private deployments run under your control so you determine egress.

Next steps: I’m happy to schedule a 30-min runbook walkthrough. Also looping in Karthik for pricing and Diego for the export manifest/playbook. Attached: redwood_audit_export_spec_v2.pdf (summary spec).

Laura — looping in operational details below; happy to cover on a call.

Export mechanics and proofs (technical)
- Snapshots: we generate daily snapshots for tenant-level evidence; on-demand extracts are generated as gzipped ndjson bundles. Each bundle includes a manifest.csv listing file name, SHA256, record_count, start/end timestamps.
- Checksums & signature: manifest is signed using Redwood's export key (and can be co-signed using customer's certificate in Private deployments). Hashes enable you to verify the exact payload delivered.
- Encryption: export bundles are encrypted at rest with AES-256; transit via HTTPS/TLS 1.2+. For Private deployments we support wrapping export archives with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP CMEK) — we will provide integration instructions in the runbook.
- EU-only export: for tenants in EU region we ensure the job runs on EU infrastructure and we stage the export to an EU-only S3 endpoint. For hosted customers we maintain process controls to avoid cross-border egress unless explicitly requested.
- Legal hold: when a legal hold is raised, our export/retention pipeline marks the affected records and prevents deletion. For typical requests the hold is applied within 24 hours, and we can produce a held-data extract within 48 hours (subject to volume).
- Deletion workflow: once purge completes the manifest includes a deletion_report.csv with object IDs and timestamps and is signed. If your audit requires, we can provide an attestation letter signed by our legal/compliance team.

Operational SLAs & cost
- Export SLA: up to 48 hours for ranges <500GB; 72–120 hours for larger volumes depending on retrieval logistics.
- Cost: exports are quoted per-GB egress + a flat packaging fee; Private deployments have an integration setup fee. Karthik, can you follow up with a ballpark on export pricing for Finvero?

Attachment: sample_manifest.csv
Links: https://docs.redwood.com/playbooks/export_and_delete_runbook
